description: Add a red glowing in-node hint on factory graph workstation nodes at progress-outcome (z-axis) anchor positions when Continue/Reject connections are blocked because stopWords are not configured, tied to the same rules that omit or disable those connect handles, with localized tooltip copy that clears when requirements are satisfied.

context.customerAsk: When a graph entity still needs completion on the z axis, render a red glowing indicator on the z-axis control/position when incomplete and blocking connection establishment, tied to the same validation/rules that disable connect gestures, with copy/tooltip explaining what must be completed to connect.
context.problem: Standard model workstations without configured stopWords do not support Continue/Reject progress-outcome routes. The graph editor omits or hides those connect handles with no in-node explanation, so operators cannot tell why connections are blocked. Connection notices only appear after failed gestures.
context.solution: Derive z-axis incomplete state from workstationSupportsProgressOutcomeRoutes and existing anchor filtering, render red pulsing orbs at Continue/Reject slots on ActivityGraphNodeShell when editor Connect mode blocks those routes, add localized factory-graph-editor messages, and wire through both buildSemanticGraphHandles and factory-graph-react-flow-projection buildNodeHandles with tests and Storybook/browser verification.

acceptanceCriteria: Workstations blocking Continue/Reject connections show a red glowing z-axis hint on the node in graph editor Connect mode
Hint visibility uses the same workstationSupportsProgressOutcomeRoutes and anchor-filter rules as connect-handle omission, not a separate flag
Hint includes accessible name and tooltip explaining stopWords must be configured on the workstation before z-axis connections are allowed
Hint clears and Continue/Reject handles work normally when stopWords are configured; no false positives on classifiers, repeaters, or fully configured workstations
Automated tests cover hint on/off fixtures; Storybook or browser verification confirms visible orb styling
ui typecheck, lint, and affected tests pass
